title: Noncommutative coarse metric geometry
summary: Motivated by coarse geometry and the classical role of Roe algebras as large-scale invariants of proper metric spaces, we show that proper quantum metric spaces as introduced by Latrémolière are noncommutative coarse spaces. This further allows us to develop a bridge between Latrémolière's framework and the W*-metric approach to quantum metric spaces. Furthermore, we construct Roe algebras for locally compact quantum metric spaces and verify that they recover the classical Roe algebras in the commutative case.
